g.text: Conceptual bearing families: rolling elements are balls or rollers; thrust stack is drawn in axial section; journal is a lubricated radial sleeve. These
sketches are not interchangeable installation drawings. Cylindrical roller axial capacity and ball axial capacity depend on the specific design.
